riskNotes.note: Agent-supplied `config` with an absolute-path `extends` executed arbitrary JS in 0.1.3; fixed in 0.1.4. Verified by execution (lint_solidity, absolute path) and at source (array, solhint:../, plugins, fix_solidity). Unchanged in 0.1.7.

Linting a repository runs that repository's own Solhint plugins and JS config (.solhint.json plugins, .solhintrc.js, solhint.config.js, a project-installed Solhint): the same trust as running `npx solhint` there. No version of this component changes that; it is not safe for untrusted repositories.

Partly resolved in 0.1.6: an unloadable plugin or unknown rule is reported as a '⚠️ degraded run' banner in the result text (not isError), and get_config no longer claims the config is sound. Not covered: if FORCE_COLOR is set in the server's environment, Solhint's warnings are coloured and not recognised, so the run looks clean.
